drafts_today.text:
Four bottles on the counter and no idea which goes first?

My order after 40:
1. Booster (spray, then wait)
2. Serum (massage in, let it absorb)
3. Booster again
4. Cream to seal

The secret isn't more product. It's letting each layer dry.

Save this for tonight.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Overhead photo of your four real jars in order (Dermatology Booster EX, Serum EX, Booster EX, Dermatology Cream) on a white towel by the bathroom window, numbered 1-4 on sticky notes.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12-15 s vertical close-up on hands: spray Booster and pause (on-screen 'wait'), massage Serum, pause, spray Booster, scoop Cream with the spatula and massage in. Start on dry skin.

drafts_today.topic: Come see me at Sunnycrest this weekend
drafts_today.text:
Sunshine Coast friends: I'll be at the Sunnycrest Winter Market this weekend, Nov 14-15.

Come try RIMAN on the back of your hand and bring your winter skin questions.

What's the one thing winter does to your skin? Tell me and I'll have an answer ready.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your table set up with the products and your sign, shot from the front at eye level in daylight; you smiling behind it if you like.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10 s: pan across the table, end on you waving. On-screen text: 'Sunnycrest, Nov 14-15. Come say hi.'

drafts_today.topic: Lip liner trick after 40 (new ICD Butter Lip Liner)
drafts_today.text:
Makeup after 40 tip nobody told me: line your lips from the centre out.

Trace the upper lip from the middle outward, then the lower lip. Fill in lightly. Soften the edge with a fingertip.

Colour stays put.

Mine is the new RIMAN ICD Butter Lip Liner.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Close-up of the Butter Lip Liner (twisted up only a little) next to a Butter Lip Tint on your vanity, soft window light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 10-12 s mirror shot: trace upper lip centre-out, then lower, fill lightly, fingertip blend, add tint and pat. On-screen text: 'Centre out.'

drafts_today.topic: GLP-1, no hype: what women our age actually need to hear
drafts_today.text:
A doctor on a big podcast just said GLP-1 drugs should be "put in the water."

No thanks.

Women in their 70s don't need hype. We need what's safe for our own bodies.

My rule: anything for weight or metabolism, I run past my doctor first.

What's your rule?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Simple photo: your morning glass on the kitchen counter by a window, with a handwritten sticky note that says 'Ask your doctor first.'
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 to 15 seconds, talking to camera in natural light: say the rule in your own words. No product claims on screen.

drafts_today.topic: Losing weight after 60? Protect your muscle
drafts_today.text:
Losing weight after 60? Ask what you're losing.

On GLP-1 drugs, a good share of the weight lost can be muscle, and stopping often brings much of the weight back.

Muscle is what keeps us steady on our feet.

Protein at every meal. Light weights. A daily walk.

Save this.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Light hand weights and walking shoes by the door, with a Sunshine Coast window view if you have it.
drafts_today.video_tip: About 12 seconds: lace up shoes, step outside, a short clip of the walk. On-screen text: 'Protein. Light weights. Daily walk.'
